source_evidence: When the exchange rate between the U.S. dollar and the currency of an international investment changes, it can increase or reduce your investment return.  In addition, some countries may impose foreign currency controls that restrict or delay investors or the company invested in from moving currency out of a country.
question: Misconception: Currency risk only affects an international investment’s return; it cannot affect whether or when money can be moved out of a country.
answer: Currency risk can affect both returns and access to funds. Exchange-rate changes can increase or reduce an investment’s return, while some countries’ currency controls can restrict or delay moving currency out of the country.
